summary: As of November 2026, LLM API pricing spans a vast range—from near-zero open-weight hosted endpoints to $10+/$50 per million tokens for flagship reasoning models. The mainstream floor for production-grade models has settled around $0.10-$0.20 per million input tokens, while prompt caching and batch discounts (typically 50%) have become standard across major vendors. Prices change frequently and several newer-generation families (OpenAI GPT-6, Anthropic Claude 5.x, Google Gemini 3.x/4) now coexist with the still widely-deployed prior-generation models the developer ecosystem continues to rely on.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount. Prompt caching discount on repeated prefixes. Remains a widely deployed enterprise default.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost high-volume model. Batch API 50% discount available. Cached input priced at half.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reduces cached read cost to ~10% of input; cache writes cost more. Batch processing 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available (Google may use content to improve products). Batch requests half price. Pricing varies by prompt length tier.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
models.notes: Cheapest text model on Google's rate card. Batch requests half price. Free tier available.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost tier. Prompt caching and 50% batch discount available.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: higher rates for prompts over 200K tokens. Batch requests half price. Free tier available.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning model. Output price includes reasoning tokens. Batch 50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: High-end reasoning model (price reduced from original launch). Reasoning tokens billed as output. Batch 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship reasoning/agentic model. Prompt caching reduces cached reads significantly; batch processing 50% discount.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Available via xAI API. Higher context tiers priced differently. Cached input discount offered.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation tier via La Plateforme. Flagship Mistral model with competitive flagship pricing.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost tier via La Plateforme. Free experimentation tier available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Open-weight Llama hosted on Together AI. Flat input/output pricing typical for hosted open models. Free trial credits available.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Hosted on Groq's high-speed LPU inference. Free tier with rate limits for developers.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open-weight Llama hosted on Fireworks. Flat per-token pricing; free trial credits available.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys with rate limits available.
